description: This Java source file defines the OutboundMappingProcessorActor class, an Akka actor responsible for processing outbound signals, enriching, filtering, mapping, and dispatching them via an internal messaging flow within the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles outbound signals, manages mapping outcomes, and integrates with metrics, enrichment, and monitoring components.

classes.name: OutboundMappingProcessorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor class responsible for processing, enriching, filtering, mapping, and dispatching outbound signals within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging framework. Implements methods for handling different signal types, managing monitors, and integrating with the signal processing pipeline.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Akka Props configuration for instantiating the OutboundMappingProcessorActor with specific parameters.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the actor's message handling behavior, including pattern matching for signals, acknowledgments, exceptions, and termination signals.

methods.name: handleNotExpectedAcknowledgement
methods.description: Handles acknowledgments that are received where none are expected, logging and discarding them.

methods.name: mapDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Maps a DittoRuntimeException into an appropriate ErrorResponse and handles it.

methods.name: mapMessage
methods.description: Converts incoming messages into the standardized OutboundSignalWithId format.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Creates an Akka Stream sink that processes outbound signals, performing enrichment, filtering, and forwarding.

methods.name: splitByTargetExtraFieldsFlow
methods.description: Flow that splits an outbound signal into multiple signals based on target extra fields and filtered topics.

methods.name: enrichAndFilterSignal
methods.description: Performs enrichment of signals with extra fields and applies filtering criteria asynchronously.

methods.name: recoverFromEnrichmentError
methods.description: Handles errors during enrichment, logging, notifying the client actor, and adjusting the outbound signal.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse
methods.description: Processes error responses, logging details and mapping responses appropriately.

methods.name: handleCommandResponse
methods.description: Handles command responses, dispatching responses or failures accordingly.

methods.name: recordResponse
methods.description: Records the outcome of a response in the metrics monitor.

methods.name: handleOutboundSignal
methods.description: Processes outbound signals and converts them into source streams for dispatch.

methods.name: forwardToPublisherActor
methods.description: Forwards the processed messaging to the client actor for publication.

methods.name: handleSignal
methods.description: Handles signals, including responses and errors, by wrapping them into outbound signals with context.

methods.name: mapToExternalMessage
methods.description: Converts outbound signals into source streams with monitoring and mapping outcome handling.
